raw_response:
I am old now, 70 years. I farm alone on my 10.1 mu. My back is not what it was, so I do what I know. I do not try new things. What worked last year, I do again.

My land — I split it. About 8 mu I do wheat then maize, one after the other, like always. The other 2.1 mu I keep in cotton. Cotton I have grown my whole life, even if picking is hard now. My neighbor's son helps me pick in autumn, I pay him some.

For seeds — I buy from the same shop in town. The maize I plant is the hybrid kind, everyone uses it, the old seed gives nothing now. Wheat same, the shop gives me the improved kind, I do not know the name, but it is what grows here. Cotton seed also from shop.

For fertilizer — I buy compound fertilizer, the 15-15-15 bag. One bag is 50 jin, I mean 50 kg. For wheat, before planting I put down 2 bags per mu as base, then in spring when it greens up I spread urea, maybe half bag per mu. For maize, same thing — 1 bag compound at planting, then urea at knee-high, almost one bag per mu because maize eats a lot. Cotton I give 1 bag compound at planting and urea twice when it flowers.

I do not measure like a scientist. I go by the bag. If last year was good, I do same. If wheat looked yellow, I add a bit more urea. Too little fertilizer and the harvest is poor — that is disaster. Too much is just money lost, but at least grain comes.

Water — I have my well. Wheat needs water 3 times: after planting, in spring, and when heading. Maize mostly gets the rain in summer, but if dry, I pump once or twice. Cotton I water 2 times, it does not like too much wet.

Pesticide — wheat I spray once for aphid in spring. Maize one spray for borer. Cotton is the hard one, bollworm comes many times, I spray 4-5 times, my neighbor tells me when his field has bugs and I spray same day.

Tillage — the tractor man comes and ploughs for me before wheat. For maize after wheat harvest I do not plough, just drill in the stubble. Cotton I plough in spring.

Yield — if heaven gives good weather, wheat maybe 450 kg per mu, maize 550 kg, cotton 250 kg of seed cotton. This is what I got last year. If less rain, less harvest, nothing I can do.
